target.value: one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

description.summary: This spell cures 4d4 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +20) from a number of creatures within range.
description.value: This spell cures 4d4 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +20) from a number of creatures within range. If you cast this spell immediately after subjects take damage, it effectively prevents the damage. Used against an undead creature, close wounds deals damage instead of curing the creature (which takes half damage if it makes a Will saving throw).
